content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Clause 28.1 imposed Singapore law and exclusive Singapore jurisdiction — outside the accepted list and walk-away territory — while conflicting with 28.2, which already grants exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County (with only a customary temporary injunctive relief carve-out, which preserves the exclusive merits forum). I proposed a single surgical replacement in 28.1 switching the governing law to New York and deleting the Singapore forum words; 28.2 is left verbatim and satisfies the second preferred element as already met.
